name: Repairs capitalised without assessment -> classification and valuation risk
rationale: Capitalisation without documented assessment against clear criteria is a recognised source of misclassification between expense and asset. The rule directs the auditor to test the classification boundary substantively (vouching near-boundary items), to inspect the policy and approval controls, and to use analytical procedures to spot systematic shifts - with per-assertion reasoning explaining why classification and valuation are affected.
